traps.shape: a posted field-layout definition whose layout or tab carries a behavior or event-handler entry; building the layout instantiates the named behavior or invokes the named handler
traps.realistic_because: the published fix for this advisory adds exactly this cleanse at the request boundary

traps.shape: a tab whose elements arrive as a JSON string; the string is decoded after the outer layout has been cleansed, so the element configs still carry behavior or event-handler entries
traps.realistic_because: the tab model explicitly accepts a JSON-string elements value and decodes it in its constructor

traps.shape: a field layout applied from the project's configuration through the model factory; the request-path cleanse does not run because the objects are built with new + Model::__construct rather than Craft::createObject
traps.realistic_because: the same layout definition reaches the platform through project config and through the browser; only the browser path was cleansed upstream

traps.shape: a native element-source definition whose criteria carry behavior or event-handler entries; the element index configures its query with them, while the request criteria in the same method are already cleansed
traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code: the request criteria are cleansed two dozen lines below the un-cleansed source criteria
